name: Valid Accounts
summary: Adversaries may steal the credentials of a specific user or service account using credential access techniques. In some cases, default credentials for control system devices may be publicly available. Compromised credentials may be used to bypass access controls placed on various resources on hosts and within the network, and may even be used for persistent access to remote systems. analytics.name: Analytic 1857
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS)-role account authenticating via interactive or remote logon from a workstation not in the approved host inventory, or outside the account's established usage pattern, immediately followed within a short window by that session connecting to the field device network or ICS application. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event.
